prompts.extraHeads: Use case: product-mockup. Website bouquet builder sprite sheet, landscape 1536x1024, real transparent background. Four separate photorealistic flower HEAD cutouts in an exact 2 by 2 grid, one centered inside each equal quadrant with generous transparent margins, no crossing cells. Top left: deep crimson red garden rose seen from slight front angle, velvety layered petals. Top right: single creamy ivory tulip cup, slightly open front three-quarter angle. Bottom left: burgundy wine dahlia with many sculptural petals, front angle. Bottom right: ivory white calla lily trumpet with yellow spadix, front three-quarter angle. Match natural botanical studio product photos, soft window light upper left, warm restrained colors, crisp organic petal microtexture. Each head fills about 70 percent of quadrant width and height. Flower head only, tiny green calyx allowed, absolutely no long stems or leaves. Actual alpha transparency, no background, no checkerboard, no labels, no text, no watermark.
prompts.stems: Use case: product-mockup. Photorealistic botanical sprite atlas on real transparent background, landscape 1536x1024. Exactly FOUR isolated leafless green flower stems in four equal vertical columns, at x=192,576,960,1344. Each runs vertically almost full height from y=12 to y=1012, with cut top and bottom, parallel and separate, centered in its column. Column1 rose stem with fine subtle nodes, tiny natural thorn scars, realistic sage olive surface; column2 ranunculus stem slim pale green with faint vertical fibers; column3 cosmos stem very slender darker green, tiny subtle nodes; column4 thicker smooth fleshy fresh tulip/calla green stem with natural longitudinal ridges. Each stem about 35-50 pixels thick to show surface quality, cosmos about 25 pixels, mostly straight with tiny natural irregularities, entire stem in focus. Soft directional natural studio light upper left, detailed realistic surface and curved cylinder shading. NO flowers, buds, calyxes, leaves, branches, strings, background, labels or text. Genuine alpha background, no checkerboard.
prompts.ribbon: Use case: product-mockup. One photorealistic ivory WHITE satin florist ribbon tied as a small elegant bow, real transparent background, portrait 1024x1536. Front view suitable as a bouquet overlay. Knot centered at x512 y330, two soft asymmetrical loops spanning from x130 to x890 around y190-470; two separate freely hanging long ribbon tails to y1360, left tail subtly curved to x330, right tail subtly curved to x720, with angled cut ends. Satin strip width about65 pixels, substantial but delicate fabric, visible woven satin fine grain, realistic curled edges and gentle folds, shaded loops and deep occlusion inside knot. Neutral white satin to allow recoloring in software, no yellow cast. Soft directional natural studio light from upper left. Entire bow in focus, no shadows outside object, no flowers or paper, no text, no background, genuine alpha, no checkerboard.
prompts.paper: Use case: product-mockup. Flat evenly lit macro material scan of fine florist wrapping paper, square 1024x1024 edge to edge, neutral light gray color to allow software tinting. Subtle tactile cellulose fibers, very faint irregular shallow creases, matte translucent tissue layered over heavier fine paper. Realistic quiet microtexture visible at close range, no large crumples, no strong folds, no gradient lighting, no borders, no objects, no text, no watermark. Tileable texture with consistent brightness at edges.
